overall_goal: Integrate fire heat distribution, building layout, firefighting resources, and trapped personnel information to predict fire spread path and generate optimal rescue dispatch plan, highlighting high-risk areas and key rescue routes for real-time decision support to the command center.

tasks.task_goal: Analyze heat distribution from visual input
tasks.expected_output: heat map indicating fire intensity and location

tasks.task_goal: Extract building layout from provided images
tasks.expected_output: detailed building layout with entry and exit points

tasks.task_goal: Identify trapped personnel and their locations
tasks.expected_output: list of detected human voices and their estimated locations
current status and location of firefighting resources
predicted fire spread path over time

tasks.task_input: fire spread path, resource status, trapped personnel locations
tasks.expected_output: rescue dispatch plan with prioritized actions

tasks.task_goal: Highlight high-risk areas and key rescue routes
tasks.task_input: rescue dispatch plan, fire spread path
tasks.expected_output: map with highlighted high-risk areas and rescue routes
